player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Langkah harus dalam bantuak [macro micro] jo angka 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Indeksnyo musti satiap ado antaro 0 jo 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Papan mikro, baris, atau kolom indak ado di jangkauan.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Pamain musti bamainan di papan mikro nan barikuiknyo.

game_action.played: Pamain {player_id} mamainkan di papan ketek {macro_idx}, sel {micro_idx} (baris {row}, kolom {col}). Pamain {opponent_id} kini harus mamainkan di {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Pamain {player_id} manang jo Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
